[NDBG.20.2] Within one timeline, `asserted` holds the facts that
entered WM in the half-open interval `[from, to)` and `retracted` those that
left it. Across two timelines, `asserted` holds the facts in WM at `to` and
not at `from`, and `retracted` the reverse. DS facts are immutable (retract +
reassert, never in-place modify), so there is no `modified` bucket.
